title: Being Kind — Loving Others Like Jesus
objective: Students will learn about kindness and how to treat others with love.
content: God wants us to be kind to everyone! Being kind means being nice and loving to other people. Jesus was the kindest person who ever lived!
We can be kind by saying nice words like 'please' and 'thank you.' We can be kind by smiling at people and giving hugs. We can be kind by including everyone in our games.
When someone is sad, we can be kind by sitting with them and being a good friend. Kindness makes other people happy, and it makes God happy too!
activity: Practice saying kind words to a friend. Draw a picture of yourself being kind to someone. Give someone a hug!
discussion: What does it mean to be kind?
How was Jesus kind to people?
How can you be kind today?
